scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and finite corroborating exact-rational checks are distinct. Historical priority is best-knowledge and provisional against specialized unindexed pulse-switching literature.
scientific_limitations: Sharp two-cycle upper bound and minimal window length are confined to piecewise-constant pure quadratic/cubic pulse words with at most four cyclic windows; arbitrary smooth, more numerous or mixed pulses and negative periodic solutions are excluded.
title: Sharp four-window switching and a two-cycle fold in the Abel equation
